name: cino-starnet
description: Thirteen provider-neutral StarNet skills for mission prompt design, multi-agent routing, context control, evidence, testing, source-of-truth, and reliability governance.

interface.longDescription: Thirteen provider-neutral StarNet skills for compiling high-fidelity overseer mission prompts, routing complex work, controlling context, resolving source authority, selecting tests, governing reusable skills, and producing evidence-grade handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Help me build the first mission prompt I should send to my StarNet overseer.
Route this complex mission across the smallest safe set of specialist agents.
Resolve the governing source of truth for this conflicting evidence.

publication.release_notes: Cino StarNet 1.1.0 adds the Overseer Mission Prompt Builder: a deep pre-launch interview and prompt compiler that turns rough intent into a CALLUS-ready mission brief while preserving StarNet's existing routing and execution boundaries.
